system.description: In place of an attack granted by the Attack Action, you can spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, you transform your body into one with a horrifying physique for a moment. When you do, all hostile creatures within 20 feet of you must make a Wisdom Saving throw vs your Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) Save DC. On a failed save they drop their weapons, and must move their full speed attempting to get away from you. A Creature who failed this save cannot cast jutsu with the hand sign (HS) requirement until the beginning of their next turn.
